name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Compact Seismic Imager CSI-2
product_name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Compact Seismic Imager CSI-2
description: A portable seismic imaging device that maps underground structures, tunnels, voids, and buried objects by analyzing the propagation of seismic waves generated by a compact thumper unit. The CSI-2 strikes the ground with a calibrated impact and measures the returning echoes from subsurface features, building a 3D model of everything within 50 meters depth. The system can identify tunnels, buried rooms, underground pipes, geological features, and anomalous density variations that might indicate buried containers or bodies.

specifications.method: Active seismic imaging with thumper source

story_hooks: A CSI-2 scan beneath a Tier 2 parking lot revealed a network of tunnels that do not appear on any utility map — the tunnels are recent construction and their purpose is unknown.

A CSI-2 has been used by a criminal investigation to locate buried evidence — the seismic image showed a container-shaped density anomaly at 3 meters depth that matched the dimensions of a missing safe.
related_entities: Arcturus Defense Solutions Pulse Carbine PC-6 'Heartbeat'

physical_description.visual_profile: A ruggedized dual-unit system: a compact pneumatic striking head (thumper) with angular reinforced housing paired with a sleek handheld analysis unit resembling a high-end surveying tablet. The thumper is industrial and brutal—all beveled edges and impact-absorbing polymers. The imager unit is more refined, featuring a large high-contrast holographic display panel.
physical_description.dimensions: Thumper unit: 35cm × 28cm × 22cm; Imager unit: 32cm × 22cm × 8cm; connected by 2-meter reinforced umbilical cable with quick-disconnect couplings
physical_description.weight_description: 4kg total (thumper: 2.2kg, imager: 1.1kg, cable/accessories: 0.7kg); highly portable with integrated shoulder carry strap and padded field pack
physical_description.primary_material: Thumper: titanium-reinforced composite with shock-absorbing elastomer dampeners; Imager: aerospace-grade aluminum frame with ballistic polycarbonate screen protection
physical_description.finish: Thumper housing: matte black with visible stress-relief ribbing; Imager: brushed aluminum with soft-grip rubberized edges; both feature faint anti-reflection coating
physical_description.color_scheme: Industrial black primary with Zheng-Dao corporate cyan accents on bezels and indicator rings; emerald-green power indicators; data visualization uses orange/white heat-map overlays on display
physical_description.interface_elements: Imager display: 8-inch holographic touchscreen showing real-time 3D subsurface models in wireframe; four physical tactile buttons (power, scan, calibrate, export); USB-C and proprietary Zheng-Dao diagnostic ports; impact counter window on thumper; pneumatic pressure gauge
distinctive_features: Visible pneumatic charge chamber with spring-loaded piston mechanism on thumper
Holographic depth-grid overlay that projects 50m scan volume as semi-transparent cyan grid
Rotating calibration ring with depth-marker notches on thumper base
Real-time seismic wave visualization on imager—cascading green waveforms tracking underground echoes
Heavy-duty mil-spec connector with audible pressure-lock confirmation
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: ZHENG-DAO HEAVY INDUSTRIES logo (stylized angular 'Z' in cyan) on both units; CSI-2 model designation in white stencil; GLMZ regulatory stamp (Tier 2+ clearance required); serial number laser-etched on frame; Chinese characters for 'Seismic Analysis' on thumper base
physical_description.condition_typical: Field-worn but maintained—scuff marks from ground contact on thumper's impact plate; micro-cracks in elastomer dampeners from repeated use; display shows light dust accumulation on protective glass; cable has reinforced wear patches at connection points
